title: ServiceRegistrationRequest
description: Information about a particular API for registration.

id.description: The ID of the service to update or create, if provided will update.

code.description: The unique code of this service.

org_id.description: The organization that owns this service.

summary.description: The quick summary of this service for basic information on why and when to use it.

path.description: The path for this service when registered in the API gateway.

icon.description: The image or logo to associate with this API which can be base64 or a URL.

url.description: The full URL for this service.

documentation_url.description: The URL where additional documentation about this service can be found

terms_url.description: The URL where terms and conditions of this API are used.

open_api_url.description: The URL where the open api specification is defined.

ping_api_url.description: The URL used to check if the service is active. If left blank we assume the default route is ok.

status.description: The URL used to check if the service is active. If left blank we assume the default route is ok.

security.description: The security to activate on this service.
